from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional, Literal

class Party(BaseModel):
    """Represents a named entity (person or company) in the case."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the party")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Their role in the proceedings, e.g., Appellant, Respondent, Plaintiff, Defendant, Creditor, Debtor")

class CourtInfo(BaseModel):
    """Contains information about the court handling the case."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the court, e.g., 'Beijing Chaoyang District People's Court'")
    level: str | None = Field(description="The court level, e.g., First Instance, Second Instance, Intermediate, High, Supreme")

class Verdict(BaseModel):
    """Represents the court's decision or ruling."""
    outcome_type: Literal["驳回上诉", "驳回申请", "维持原判", "撤销原判", "改判", "准许撤回", "指定管辖", "驳回申诉", "驳回再审申请"] = Field(description="The general type of outcome observed in the verdict")
    outcome_description: str | None = Field(description="The full text or summary of the verdict order as written in the document")

class FeeDetails(BaseModel):
    """Represents litigation costs and their allocation."""
    fee_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of fee, e.g., 'First Instance', 'Second Instance', 'Publication Fee'")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who pays the fee, e.g., 'Appellant', 'Plaintiff', 'Defendant'")
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The specific amount, e.g., '300 yuan', '2300 yuan'")

class MonetaryAward(BaseModel):
    """Represents specific financial orders or compensation amounts."""
    recipient: str | None = Field(description="Who receives the money")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who pays the money")
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The amount awarded, e.g., '7922 yuan'")
    reason: str | None = Field(description="What the money is for, e.g., 'Pension compensation', 'Bank account split'")

class CaseDetails(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates the key extractable information from a single judgment document."""
    parties: list[Party]
    court: list[CourtInfo]
    verdict: Verdict
    fees: list[FeeDetails]
    monetary_awards: list[MonetaryAward]
    case_numbers: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Case numbers mentioned in the document")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="General category of the case, e.g., Civil, Criminal, Administrative")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Top-level container for all extracted document instances."""
    documents: list[CaseDetails]
